install: sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq python3-venv python3-pip >/dev/null && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -U pip && .venv/bin/pip install -r backend/requirements.txt -r backend/requirements-dev.txt

terminals.name: applypilot
terminals.command: test -f config/.env || cp config/.env.example config/.env; PYTHONPATH=backend .venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --app-dir backend
terminals.description: ApplyPilot API + dashboard on port 8000 with twice-daily scheduler
